study: Physics-derived service world-model and canonical-recovery diagnostic
scope: Architecture/native-contract audit and training-only headroom measurement; not SOTA or novelty certification
legacy_comparator: Also run unmodified pending-expiry semantics as a separate numerical reference; any benefit from expiring stale commands is a classical control change, not JEPA
selection: Two lowest available observed pilot margins and one uniformly sampled other available robot; never select using future labels
interventions: move to strongest other AP in completed local scan cache
factual_comparator: No forced action: canonical RadioMap continuation with its actual future packets, scans and forecasts
counterfactual_semantics: Change only one focal action for one second, then restore canonical recovery. Preserve full-duration channel draws, packet RNG, queues, observation delivery and other actors. Baseline is never a forced ten-second stay.
headroom: Report beneficial/harmful/zero actual packet differences and best recorded hindsight action. Future-informed selection is explicitly NONCAUSAL, not an executable policy or model performance claim.
observations: Preserve AP/band axes, measured/cache values, masks, receiver freshness, public route/geometry, completed forecasts, packet age/outcomes, configured MCS and queues. Unknown neighbor ages remain unknown.
model: Shared masked radio memory, known-edge messages, recurrent observation belief, action-conditioned Gaussian latent rollouts and zero-initialized physics residual heads. Optional JEPA future-latent pretraining. Established components, not a new architecture claim.
novelty_gate: Direct prior-art overlap blocks broad first-of-kind claims; bounded search cannot prove nobody did an exact method
sota_gate: Needs independent matched comparisons against strongest published methods; upstream forward checks do not qualify and missing official resources remain gaps
activation: Inactive prototype; neither invariants nor hindsight headroom qualifies learned control
